about: Every id of the Grapes tab at the table, grape by grape in the roster's order: three cards and three questions each, gt- and eight base36 digits minted by build-grapes.cjs from the slug and the text (a card's front, a question's stem). While frozen is false the file follows the writing build. Once the integrator has frozen it (build-grapes.cjs --freeze, the roster whole) a build may add ids and may never lose one: an id is a learner's saved record, and a reworded front or stem is a new id that orphans it.
